tools.name: list_opt_out_guides
tools.description: Summaries of every curated website guide and retired-site explanation, without duplicates. Includes kind, domain, category, documented method and content review date. Undocumented facts are null. Supports paging and category filters.

tools.name: get_removal_route
tools.description: For any of the 950+ sites in the takedown registry: the documented removal method (form, email, both, guide, or none), the opt-out URL and privacy email on record, the parent company that actually processes the request, sibling sites one request may cover, and a link to our step-by-step guide when o

tools.name: search_privacy_library
tools.description: Search My Privacy Agent's published articles, opt-out guides, help answers, and plan facts about data brokers, opt-outs, relisting, pricing and service limitations. Returns ranked hits with canonical source URLs.

tools.name: get_service_overview
tools.description: The public service description: tool scope, optional website pages for a private check, listing review and pricing, service limitations, and registry statistics. Contains public reference information only.

tools.name: get_route_verification
tools.description: Read the exact official route variants for a domain or route ID, current independently checked scope, actor and region, capture time, expiry and failures. No badge means the route is not currently verified. This never starts a check or submits a request.

tools.name: get_library_verification_status
tools.description: Read the actual catalog size, distinct route variants, current verified counts, checks captured today and the latest scheduled sweep. Counts include only native evidence that is still current; inventory rows, aliases and agent callbacks never count as verified.

tools.name: list_my_subjects
tools.description: Requires OAuth. Lists the person (first name, city, state, verification status) whose exposure this account has checked, with the subject_id used by account tools. Account setup and grant requirements are returned as structured statuses.

tools.name: get_my_report
tools.description: Requires OAuth and the 'share_results' permission for the subject. Returns the report summary the dashboard shows: status, counts, and per-site findings (site, status, what it exposes, guide link). No listing URLs or observed values are included. Returns authorization_required with a connect URL whe

tools.name: list_my_cases
tools.description: Requires OAuth and the 'share_results' permission. Lists removal cases with site, action, exact request status, verification status, human-only steps and dates. Filed, pending, needs review and verified removed are distinct states.

tools.name: get_case_status
tools.description: Requires OAuth and the 'share_results' permission. Returns one case by case_id with its current status, verification status, and any step only the person can do.

tools.name: request_recheck
tools.description: Requires OAuth and the 'run_check' permission. Queues a fresh check of the person's existing details (the same re-scan Patrol runs monthly). Patrol plan only, verified subjects only, once per 24 hours; it never starts a first check and never takes new details. Returns queued, or a structured reason

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_opt_out_instructions, list_opt_out_guides, get_removal_route, search_privacy_library, get_service_overview, get_my_report, list_my_cases · Private data: get_removal_route, get_service_overview · Public sink: get_removal_route, submit_approved_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_opt_out_instructions, list_opt_out_guides, get_removal_route, search_privacy_library, get_service_overview, get_my_report, list_my_cases · Private data: get_removal_route, get_service_overview · Public sink: get_removal_route, submit_approved_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
